### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must impose enforceable safeguards and firm limits before these systems are created.

2. We reject the idea that mass casualties are an acceptable cost of technological progress. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. Prevention must begin now.

3. We still have the power to prevent catastrophe. If superintelligent AI is built within 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We need meaningful oversight and enforceable limits before it is too late.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. The stakes are not abstract, and the danger is not confined to science fiction. Systems more capable than any human could be turned toward mass violence, sabotage, coercion, or catastrophic attacks at unprecedented speed and scale. We refuse to treat that outcome as an acceptable cost of technological progress. That is why we are calling for enforceable safeguards, meaningful public oversight, and firm limits before such systems are created. Preventing this disaster must be a defining public priority now, while we still have the power to act.
